text: Shoulder or back strain from carrying a heavy bag, in some cases a laptop-loaded work bag, is a reason some people give for switching to a backpack.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0021. Stated reasons; prior bags include totes, handbags and work bags.

text: Several people who switched to a backpack for comfort describe it as less attractive or juvenile-looking, or as something they settled for; one says she would still choose a tote if she did not carry a laptop.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0022. Prior bags vary (tote, handbag, unstated); no frequency or repurchase data.

text: In work-bag and laptop-bag threads, some people say they do not want a bag that looks like a school bag or hiking gear, and two reject Longchamp nylon totes for looking cheap or lacking structure.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0025. Stated preferences about appearance; no purchase data.

text: Several commenters expect PU or vegan leather to peel or wear out with use, while a few owners report vegan bags that held up, one for about four and a half years without cracking or peeling.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0026. Beliefs plus individual owner reports; one source is about jackets; nothing about the Lévant material.

text: One commenter says they bought a vegan-leather jacket only because it was cheap on sale and that none of their faux-leather items has aged well past five years; another shopper ruled out a vegan-leather work tote as too pricey for vegan leather.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0027. Two individuals; one about a jacket; the tote case does not name peeling as the reason.

text: In self-selected complaint threads, Nordace backpack owners report zipper, strap or fabric failures, with stated timings from under a month to a little over two years, while other owners in the same threads report many years of use.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0028. Nordace backpacks, not the Lévant tote; not a failure rate.

text: After reading negative Nordace reviews or the brand's public replies on Reddit, several would-be buyers said or implied they would not buy or would hold off (one reported about a partner); these are intentions, not verified non-purchases, and the reply-driven ones cluster in two threads.
Two buyers describe Nordace offering a partial refund as the alternative to returning the bag at their own cost; for one of them the return address was in Hong Kong.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0030. Two individual accounts; policies may have changed.

text: Two commenters cite heavy ad retargeting or a sale countdown that reset as reasons they became suspicious of Nordace.
scope_limits: Revision of C-0031. Individual accounts of suspicion, not proven misconduct.
